accepted.scope: It is not a sideways lean of a ship or wall; it is a set of names or items in order.
examples: I wrote a list of things to buy at the shop.
Her name is at the top of the list.

accepted.definition: the property possessed by a line or surface that departs from the vertical
accepted.simpleMeaning: a slight lean to one side.
accepted.scope: It is not a set of names or items; it is a sideways lean of a ship, wall or other object.
examples: The boat developed a list to the left.
The old tower has a slight list after years of settling.

accepted.definition: make ready or suitable or equip in advance for a particular purpose or for some use, event, etc
accepted.simpleMeaning: to get something or someone set up in advance for a use or event.
accepted.scope: It is not the adjective describing someone who is prepared; it is the action of getting things set up in advance.
examples: The crew readied the boat for the storm.
She readied herself for the interview.
